row_provenance_note: Written directly from the source document by a human-directed agent session, not generated by an LLM prompted to produce Q&A pairs and not realigned against retriever output. Authored to close a coverage gap: an incident showed graph_node/comparative_node routing misgrounding a real answer on a comparison-phrased question, and no existing golden exercised the chat-graph routing paths (as opposed to plain /search) at all. This dataset is a deliberate holdout covering every phrasing archetype the chat graph can route on -- pure keyword, pure comparison, pure semantic-intent, every pairwise combination of those three, genuine one-hop relational questions, corpus-scale summary/global questions, and compound questions that are only partially grounded in the source (mixed_grounding) -- against one document whose concepts sit close together, the exact shape that exposed the incident. A companion file, retrieval_and_memory_tutorial_unanswerable.jsonl, holds questions with no answer in this document at all and is scored separately (see its own meta.json) because mixing polarities would corrupt answer_rate. Each row's context_hint is a verbatim substring of DATA/papers/retrieval_and_memory_tutorial.md, mechanically verified unique (occurs exactly once) before this file was written by the generation script that produced it.
